card.name: Equals signs and leading digits in numbers
card.fires_on: Equals signs in formulas and the first digit of a number in dose, table or fold-change text. It fires at the start of a numeric value, not on words.

modes.label: Equals sign
modes.description: An = sign in a formula or sum, just before a value.

modes.label: Leading digit
modes.description: The first digit of a number in a dose, range, fold change or table cell.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a number or result is about to begin, such as after an equals sign or at the first digit of a dose.
